name: Meross Smart Wi-Fi Plug Mini MSS110 (US, HomeKit)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; Meross says Enterprise Wi-Fi is not supported.

matter.note: The MSS110 pages describe HomeKit, not Matter. Meross's Matter mini plug is the separate MSS115. We found no explicit statement either way for the MSS110.

apple_home.note: HomeKit (HAP) over Wi-Fi; the HomeKit unit is sold as MSS110HK (US/CA). Remote control needs an Apple home hub (HomePod, Apple TV or iPad).

google_home.note: Through the Meross 'Works with Google Home' account link; add the plug in the Meross app first.

alexa.note: Through the Meross Alexa skill, linked to your Meross account.

smartthings.note: Meross's MSS110US page lists SmartThings. It connects by linking your Meross account in the SmartThings app (cloud to cloud), per Meross's generic SmartThings FAQ.

home_assistant.note: No official Meross integration in Home Assistant. Forum users report pairing it via the HomeKit Device integration or the community Meross LAN add-on, but no official page names this model.

hubRequired.note: Joins your existing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi directly; no bridge needed. An Apple home hub is only needed for remote HomeKit control.

localControl.note: HomeKit accessories normally work over the LAN, but we found no Meross page that states local control for this model.

energyMonitoring.note: Meross's US/JP MSS110 page lists Energy Monitor: No. For metering, Meross sells other models (e.g. the MSS315).

maxLoadWatts.note: Meross rates the US/CA/JP version at 15 A / 1800 W.

summary: The Meross MSS110 is a compact US/Canada Wi-Fi plug with built-in HomeKit, so it pairs straight into Apple Home without Matter. Meross also lists Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings through its account link. It runs on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with no hub and is rated 15 A / 1800 W.
caveats: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; Enterprise Wi-Fi networks aren't supported.
Controlling it from outside the home in Apple Home needs an Apple home hub (HomePod, Apple TV or iPad).
Not the Matter model: Meross's Matter mini plug is the MSS115.
